page.layout: One printed page, title page. Top: author line across the full width. Then centred title lines. Centre: woodcut of a tree with a figure and banner. Bottom: imprint in centred lines. Ghosted show-through text from the reverse page is not transcribed.
page.notes: Woodcut engraving in the centre showing a tree with a figure holding a spear, and a banner reading "ET FLORO" and "VNUCI..." (partly illegible). A handwritten monogram appears in the upper right and a manuscript pressmark at the top right corner; these are not transcribed. Greek "Προπαιδείας" is copied as printed. Ghosted show-through text of the reverse page is omitted.
